title: Stasis Samurai
description: Four identical panels of a bald man in a metallic silver bodysuit and gloves are arranged horizontally against a bright pink background. He is posed dynamically in a fighting stance with fists raised. Behind the panels is large, bold black text reading 'STASIS SAMURAI' layered over translucent plastic sheets.
prompt: A vibrant pop art composition featuring four identical rectangular panels arranged in a row on a solid hot pink background. Each panel shows a bald muscular man wearing a tight metallic silver bodysuit and gloves, posed in an aggressive fighting stance with fists raised and an intense expression. Behind the panels is large bold black 3D text spelling STASIS SAMURAI, partially covered by layered translucent plastic sheets with visible folds and reflections.
